instruction: Candid studio photograph, medium shot. In a bright indoor dance studio with white paneled walls, the instructor in a black long-sleeved top (R1) stands behind the young student in a pink tutu (R2). The young student stands in profile facing left with her arms raised high and one leg extended back. The instructor places both of her hands on the student's waist to adjust her posture, looking forward with a neutral, focused expression. Soft, bright natural light illuminates the clean white setting, creating a gentle and focused atmosphere.
